Purchase options and add-ons

  • EASY TO TEAR: No scissors needed! You can easily unwind and tear OK TAPE athletic tape by hand for quick and effective taping
  • DURABLE: With the superior adhesive, our sports tape stays firmly in place where it is needed even through sweat and rain
  • SUPPORTIVE: Rigid, non-stretch medical adhesive tape provides more stability than elastic bandage; It is ideal for securing splints and bulky dressings, supporting wrists and fingers
  • VERSATILE: Athletic tape can also be used on sports equipment like hockey sticks, baseball batsis and barbells; Great for taping dog's ears and legs without pulling fur off
  • 1.5 inches x 15 yards per roll; Made of 100% cotton backcloth with a latex-free adhesive; Help reduce skin irritation by prewrapping with OK TAPE underwrap

    • Ed
      5 out of 5 stars
      Strong Tape, Easy to Use. Great Value for the Price!
      Reviewed in the United States on July 16, 2025
      Size: 15 yardsColor: White-4 Rolls
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      I've been using athletic tape for years as a coach and parent of a young athlete, and this tape definitely surprised me in a good way. It is the standard size for most athletic tapes.

      It’s strong, easy to tear by hand, and doesn’t leave behind a huge sticky mess like some of the other brands I've used. The grip is solid for ankles, wrists, and even fingers, and it holds up well during practice and games.

      The fact that it comes in a 4-pack makes it a great value, and I like that it’s not overly rigid.

      It has a little give but still provides support.

    About this Item

    • EASY TO TEAR: No scissors needed! You can easily unwind and tear OK TAPE athletic tape by hand for quick and effective taping
    • DURABLE: With the superior adhesive, our sports tape stays firmly in place where it is needed even through sweat and rain
    • SUPPORTIVE: Rigid, non-stretch medical adhesive tape provides more stability than elastic bandage; It is ideal for securing splints and bulky dressings, supporting wrists and fingers
    • VERSATILE: Athletic tape can also be used on sports equipment like hockey sticks, baseball batsis and barbells; Great for taping dog's ears and legs without pulling fur off
    • 1.5 inches x 15 yards per roll; Made of 100% cotton backcloth with a latex-free adhesive; Help reduce skin irritation by prewrapping with OK TAPE underwrap

    Product Description

    For muscle and joint support during any sport, to prevent bumps and bruises during everyday life, use the easy-tear OK TAPE Athletic Tape.

    -Easily unwinds and tears for convenient application

    -No residue, no pulling, easy off

    -Powerful rigid hold. Provides firm support and compression

    -Great for taping baseball bats, hockey sticks and tennis rackets for grip
